name: work-orchestrator-extension-setup
description: One-time setup skill that explores a project's gates, protected paths, conduct rules, recurring checkpoint types, and session topology, drafts the extension content conversationally, and writes the per-skill extension files for the work-orchestrator plugin (orchestrating-subagent-work and orchestrating-session-work; delivery ships with work-orchestrator 4.0.0 or later). Includes a re-sync mode that audits existing extension files for drift against the current project. Long plugin and skill names are intentional to prevent accidental invocation. Renamed from subagent-orchestrator-extension-setup
